view-01.png.evidence: Aircraft on the outside of the swarm remain distinguishable.
view-01.png.regressions: Soft circular particles hide deck features and objectives intersect the scene.

view-02.png.evidence: Large field and sea areas are distinct in layout and color.
view-02.png.regressions: The objective covers the plane and the field grid overwhelms the softer plane silhouette.

view-03.png.evidence: Open sea separates cleanly from the airfield; plane and navigation arrow remain legible.
view-03.png.regressions: Straight beach edge and soft terrain lose surface definition.

view-04.png.evidence: Runway, yard and varied buildings read as one facility; ring distinguishes the aircraft.
view-04.png.regressions: Soft roof edges and broad grass patches limit fine material detail.

view-05.png.evidence: Dark water and a clear player ring provide useful hierarchy; markings and warm hits survive on deck.
view-05.png.regressions: Aircraft crowd the deck edges; the wake remains hazy.

view-06.png.evidence: Sharp blue ring and legible buildings stand against graduated shallow water.
view-06.png.regressions: Shore foam is thin and segmented; grass still broadly mottled.

view-07.png.evidence: Clear ring, crisp deck lines and dark island shadow make the quiet fleet scene easy to read.
view-07.png.regressions: Long soft wake has little texture variation near the stern.

view-08.png.evidence: Red wing discs and darker fuselage panels read as distinct paint on the sharp cream aircraft. Their repeated livery unifies the swarm, and orange hits stay distinct from the red discs.
view-08.png.regressions: The cyan ring also encloses part of a cream plane, and overlapping wings and smoke still mask the bow pilot.

view-09.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft and facility lines; teal water cleanly separates from grass.
view-09.png.regressions: Beach line is too uniform and detached white flecks give little surf depth.

view-10.png.evidence: Sharp runway threshold and differentiated buildings, with grounded tree shadows and a clear aircraft ring.
view-10.png.regressions: Wide areas of grass are still soft; shore foam reads as separate short marks.

view-11.png.evidence: Blue ring and warm sparks establish roles even through a crowd of cream wings.
view-11.png.regressions: Soft marks, dense overlaps and clipped top-edge aircraft lose fine readability.

view-12.png.evidence: Dark fuselage panels and red discs distinguish the cream wings from the blue-gray player in open water. The cyan ring, gold pipper and sparks remain separate cues.
view-12.png.regressions: Softness and overlapping silhouettes around the bow obscure individual aircraft. The new shading is subtle at this scale.

view-13.png.evidence: Dark centers and red roundels are visible on the outer cream wings and the cyan ring still tags the bow region.
view-13.png.regressions: Overlap with the deck and cyan ring still makes identification at the bow take a beat. Soft deck and aircraft edges limit the material detail.

view-14.png.evidence: Illuminated wall rims and cool room shadows organize a detailed floor plan; colored marks distinguish routes.
view-14.png.regressions: Small markings and dense furniture require a closer look.

view-15.png.evidence: Sharp blue ring and legible buildings stand against graduated shallow water.
view-15.png.regressions: Shore foam is thin and segmented; grass still broadly mottled.

view-16.png.evidence: Blue ring identifies the player and the island structure casts a readable deck shadow.
view-16.png.regressions: Soft edges, limited water scale variation and smoky wake.

view-17.png.evidence: Single light carrier remains easy to locate.
view-17.png.regressions: Blurred bow aircraft merges into the deck; the slab-like wake and center labels flatten the image.

view-18.png.evidence: Dark centers and saturated red discs make a consistent livery across the crisp cream wings. A dark blue-gray player is readable inside the cyan circle with open water beside it.
view-18.png.regressions: A cream aircraft still overlaps the bow ring and its gold pipper. Wakes remain soft.

view-19.png.evidence: The ring, cream wings and warm sparks remain distinguishable over deep blue water.
view-19.png.regressions: Overlaps over the deck are busy, and repeated smoke forms have limited scale variation.

view-20.png.evidence: Clear ring, crisp deck lines and dark island shadow make the quiet fleet scene easy to read.
view-20.png.regressions: Long soft wake has little texture variation near the stern.

view-21.png.evidence: Sharp runway and field boundaries make the scene easy to parse at a glance.
view-21.png.regressions: Objective overlaps aircraft; generic water flecks do little to connect water to shore.

view-22.png.evidence: Market stalls, detailed paving and long shadows create consistent visual space; route marks remain identifiable.
view-22.png.regressions: Similar dark human silhouettes are easy to lose beside stalls.

view-23.png.evidence: Low fog, long shadows and differentiated foliage establish layered terrain.
view-23.png.regressions: Distant troops and some armor merge into the muted haze.

view-24.png.evidence: Wet surface highlights, reflected light, smoke and wreckage reinforce a layered weather scene.
view-24.png.regressions: Small troops and the tank merge with dark ground in parts of the frame.

view-25.png.evidence: Sharp runway threshold and differentiated buildings, with grounded tree shadows and a clear aircraft ring.
view-25.png.regressions: Wide areas of grass are still soft; shore foam reads as separate short marks.

view-26.png.evidence: Pale aircraft still show against blue water.
view-26.png.regressions: Deck overlap, a rigid wake, center text and fuzzy circular effects reduce separation.

view-27.png.evidence: Pale aircraft stand out over blue water.
view-27.png.regressions: Blocky wake and center overlays disrupt depth; circular particles conceal deck detail.

view-28.png.evidence: White wings remain recognizable even at high density.
view-28.png.regressions: Large translucent circles hide the deck and indicators; wake is a rectangular slab.

view-29.png.evidence: Runway is apparent even with soft output.
view-29.png.regressions: The plane and the objective collide; simplified roofs and mottled ground have little relief.

view-30.png.evidence: Thin silhouettes and deck details survive crowded action; several plane shadows separate height.
view-30.png.regressions: Sea flecks and combat flecks have similar scale, with aircraft partly behind HUD.

view-31.png.evidence: A clear blue ring separates the player from grass and stones; shallow water grades into the sea.
view-31.png.regressions: Soft terrain and thin disconnected shore streaks limit finish.

view-32.png.evidence: Runway, yard and varied buildings read as one facility; ring distinguishes the aircraft.
view-32.png.regressions: Soft roof edges and broad grass patches limit fine material detail.

view-33.png.evidence: Sharp pale aircraft and good carrier markings help separate the formation.
view-33.png.regressions: Water glints resemble tracer flecks; the bow pileup remains ambiguous.

view-34.png.evidence: Runway orientation and blocks of farmland are quick to recognize.
view-34.png.regressions: Objective overlays the plane; spotted ground, polygonal trees and straight white shore compete.

view-35.png.evidence: A clear blue ring separates the player from grass and stones; shallow water grades into the sea.
view-35.png.regressions: Soft terrain and thin disconnected shore streaks limit finish.

view-36.png.evidence: Blue ring identifies the player and the island structure casts a readable deck shadow.
view-36.png.regressions: Soft edges, limited water scale variation and smoky wake.

view-37.png.evidence: Deck remains visible through restrained combat particles and aircraft separate against teal water.
view-37.png.regressions: Several aircraft cross the deck or HUD; low resolution merges fine smoke and markings.

view-38.png.evidence: Single carrier and distinct deck markings read quickly against restrained teal water.
view-38.png.regressions: Player nose is close to the bow; the wake is soft and simple.

view-39.png.evidence: Consistent hangar group and runway markings carry the facility read.
view-39.png.regressions: Blue aircraft merges with a similarly colored roof; simple beach and fuzzy scenery.

view-40.png.evidence: Sharp runway and neat building silhouettes with useful raised geometry.
view-40.png.regressions: The player merges with a blue roof; broad flat greens and a straight shore lack transition detail.

view-41.png.evidence: Cream wings and the carrier remain distinct against largely quiet water.
view-41.png.regressions: Bow overlaps several aircraft and soft effects convey little impact.

view-42.png.evidence: Layered silhouettes, glows and cool terrain support a strongly localized explosion.
view-42.png.regressions: The right burst and busy silhouettes conceal some units.

view-43.png.evidence: Crisp deck lines and raised island clarify orientation; short highlights mark the sea.
view-43.png.regressions: Wake remains soft and the player overlaps the bow.

view-44.png.evidence: Aircraft and blue player ring separate from the textured deck and dark sea.
view-44.png.regressions: Fallback softness and two aircraft overlapping the deck complicate identification.

view-45.png.evidence: Isolated carrier silhouette and bright deck stripes are distinct.
view-45.png.regressions: Bow aircraft is nearly part of the deck and the rigid rectangular wake flattens the scene.
